context: A grandma tells her young granddaughter a heartfelt story
purpose: Teach: 幼児/こころ/叫び/貧しい/筈/云々/前者/師匠

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ひなね、おばあちゃんが幼児だった頃、戦争で家がとても貧しい時代があったのよ。
lines.en: You know Hina, when grandma was a tiny child, there was a time our family was very poor because of the war.
lines.style: Warm, slow storytelling voice with gentle nostalgia

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ええっ、おばあちゃんも小さい子だったの?こころが痛くなるお話?
lines.en: Whaat, grandma was a little kid too? Is this a story that hurts the heart?
lines.style: Curious, wide-eyed child tone with innocent wonder

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ええ、ご飯が少なくてね、お腹が空きすぎて思わず叫びたくなる夜もあったの。
lines.en: Yes, food was scarce, and there were nights I was so hungry I almost wanted to cry out.
lines.style: Soft and reflective, slightly trembling with old memories

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: そんな…でもね、誰かが助けてくれたよね?ね?
lines.en: No way... but, somebody helped you, right? Right?
lines.style: Hopeful, slightly worried child voice asking earnestly

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、近所に書道の師匠がいてね、毎晩おにぎりを分けてくださったの。
lines.en: Yes, there was a calligraphy master nearby, and every night he shared rice balls with us.
lines.style: Affectionate, grateful tone recalling a kind elder

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: わあ、優しい人!きっと助けてくれる筈だって思ってたよ、ひな!
lines.en: Wow, what a kind person! Hina just knew someone had to help you!
lines.style: Bright, relieved child voice bursting with feeling

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ふふ、お金云々じゃなくてね、前者よりずっと大切なのは人のこころなのよ。
lines.en: Hehe, it wasn't about money or anything like that — far more important than the former is people's hearts.
lines.style: Tender teaching voice, passing wisdom to next generation

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ひな、おばあちゃんみたいに優しい人になる!
lines.en: Hina is going to become a kind person just like grandma!
lines.style: Excited, determined child voice making a small vow
